title: Treesa-Gayatri Secure Historic World Championships Bronze
indian_angle: This marks India's continued success in women's doubles, securing a historic bronze medal at the BWF World Championships.
summary: Indian duo Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand claimed a bronze medal at the BWF World Championships after their semi-final defeat, marking a significant achievement for Indian women's doubles.

title: Gopichand Outlines Asian Games Strategy Post World Championships
indian_angle: National coach Pullela Gopichand details India's focused training plans for the upcoming Asian Games, building on the recent World Championships success.
summary: Following Treesa Jolly and Gayatri Gopichand's bronze at the World Championships, coach Pullela Gopichand discusses India's strategic preparations for the Asian Games, emphasizing a step-by-step approach.

title: India Open Super 750 Tournament to Relocate to Guwahati in 2028
indian_angle: The prestigious India Open Super 750 tournament will be hosted in Guwahati starting 2028, expanding the reach of top-tier badminton within the country.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has announced that the India Open Super 750 tournament will be moved to Guwahati in 2028, signifying a shift in the hosting of this major international event.

title: Coaching Camp for Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships in Guwahati
indian_angle: This camp at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati is crucial for preparing India's young talent for the upcoming Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships.
summary: An Indian team coaching camp is underway at the National Center of Excellence in Guwahati, preparing junior players for the Badminton Asia U17 & U15 Junior Championships 2026.

title: New 3x15 Scoring System Implemented for Domestic Junior Tournaments
indian_angle: The implementation of the 3x15 scoring system in domestic junior tournaments aims to modernize play and align with evolving international standards for young Indian players.
summary: The Badminton Association of India has introduced a new 3x15 scoring system for domestic ranking tournaments and national championships across U-13, U-15, and U-17 age groups.
